entries.name: Information, advice and guidance qualification
entries.definition: A UK vocational qualification showing competence in giving people information, advice and guidance on learning and work, offered by several awarding organisations.

entries.name: Instrument rating
entries.definition: A pilot qualification, added to a pilot licence or certificate, that allows flying by reference to cockpit instruments in cloud and poor visibility under instrument flight rules.

entries.name: International Board Certified Lactation Consultant
entries.definition: A certification for lactation consultants, awarded by the International Board of Lactation Consultant Examiners.

entries.name: International Computer Driving Licence
entries.definition: An entry-level computer skills certification, earlier known as the European Computer Driving Licence, awarded after tests at approved centres under the ICDL Foundation.

entries.name: International General Certificate of Secondary Education
entries.definition: An internationally aimed secondary-school qualification, taken at about age 16 and awarded by several exam boards such as Cambridge and Pearson Edexcel, comparable to the GCSE.

entries.name: IPMA Certified Project Management Associate
entries.definition: The entry-level of the four IPMA project management certification levels, known as Level D.

entries.name: ITIL Expert
entries.definition: A top-level ITIL version 3 qualification earned by collecting credits from intermediate ITIL modules.

entries.name: ITIL Foundation
entries.definition: The entry-level ITIL qualification, covering the basic concepts and terms of ITIL service management.

entries.name: ITIL Practitioner
entries.definition: An ITIL qualification on adopting and adapting ITIL guidance in an organisation, including through continual service improvement.

entries.name: Jamf certification
entries.definition: Certifications awarded by Jamf, the Apple device management software company, showing skill in managing Apple devices with Jamf products.

entries.name: Juris Doctor
entries.definition: The professional law degree awarded in the United States and some other countries after law school, and a usual requirement to sit the bar exam in the US.

entries.name: Kenya Certificate of Primary Education
entries.definition: A certificate awarded by the Kenya National Examinations Council to pupils who sit the national examination at the end of primary school.

entries.name: Kenya Certificate of Secondary Education
entries.definition: A certificate awarded by the Kenya National Examinations Council to students who sit the national examination at the end of secondary school.

entries.name: Leadership certificate
entries.definition: A certificate awarded by a university, professional body or training provider for completing a course in leadership.

entries.name: LEED Accredited Professional
entries.definition: A professional credential from the Green Building Certification Institute showing advanced knowledge of the LEED green building rating system.

entries.name: LEED Green Associate
entries.definition: An entry-level professional credential from the Green Building Certification Institute showing basic knowledge of green building and the LEED rating system.

entries.name: Legal Nurse Consultant Certified
entries.definition: A certification for registered nurses who pass an exam in legal nurse consulting, awarded by the American Legal Nurse Consultant Certification Board.

entries.name: Licensed insurance producer
entries.definition: A licence, issued by a US state, that allows a person to sell insurance products in that state.

entries.name: Licensed Practical Nurse
entries.definition: A US state licence for nurses who provide basic nursing care under the direction of registered nurses and physicians.

entries.name: Licensed Professional Engineer
entries.definition: A US state licence that allows an engineer to approve and take legal responsibility for engineering work.

entries.name: Loss Prevention Certified
entries.definition: A certification from the Loss Prevention Foundation for retail loss prevention professionals.

entries.name: Lymphedema certification
entries.definition: A certification showing training in assessing and treating lymphedema, awarded by various training bodies and certifying boards.

entries.name: Master of Business Administration
entries.definition: A postgraduate degree in business management and administration.

entries.name: Master of Fine Arts
entries.definition: A postgraduate degree in a creative or performing art such as painting, creative writing, theatre or film.

entries.name: Master of Health Administration
entries.definition: A postgraduate degree in managing hospitals, health systems and other healthcare organisations.

entries.name: Master of Laws
entries.definition: A postgraduate law degree taken after a first law degree.

entries.name: Master of Laws in Taxation
entries.definition: A postgraduate law degree that specialises in tax law.

entries.name: Master of Public Administration
entries.definition: A postgraduate degree in managing government agencies and public-service organisations.

entries.name: Master of Science in Nursing
entries.definition: A postgraduate nursing degree that prepares nurses for advanced clinical, teaching or leadership roles.

entries.name: Master's certificate in project management
entries.definition: A graduate-level certificate programme in project management, shorter than a master's degree.

entries.name: Master's in Accounting
entries.definition: A postgraduate degree in accounting, awarded by universities.

entries.name: Master's in Advertising
entries.definition: A postgraduate degree in advertising, awarded by universities.

entries.name: Master's in Aerospace Engineering
entries.definition: A postgraduate degree in aerospace engineering, awarded by universities.

entries.name: Master's in Animation
entries.definition: A postgraduate degree in animation, awarded by universities.

entries.name: Master's in Anthropology
entries.definition: A postgraduate degree in anthropology, awarded by universities.

entries.name: Master's in Archaeology
entries.definition: A postgraduate degree in archaeology, awarded by universities.

entries.name: Master's in Archival Studies
entries.definition: A postgraduate degree in archival studies, awarded by universities.

entries.name: Master's in Art
entries.definition: A postgraduate degree in art, awarded by universities.

entries.name: Master's in Art Education
entries.definition: A postgraduate degree in art education, awarded by universities.

entries.name: Master's in Art History
entries.definition: A postgraduate degree in art history, awarded by universities.
